authorize.ts — J5 hold (POST /billing/pa.swagger_description: "Create draft document?\nLeave empty to use the application setting.\nPlease note, when using AuthoriseOnly, documents will always be issued as \"Draft\"."
authorize.ts — J5 hold (POST /billing/pa.note: swagger ties the FORCED-draft behavior specifically to AuthoriseOnly (a field we never send) — not to AutoCapture:false. Separately, help.sumit.co.il's own article states J5-hold Orders come out in draft status regardless ('הזמנות בסטטוס טיוטה'). These two SUMIT sources describe different triggers for the same draft outcome; whether our explicit DraftDocument:false is a no-op or could conflict with the help-article behavior is unverified.

action_items: authorize.ts: remove VATRate (and reconsider VATIncluded) now that the Order document is created — matches capture.ts's own verified-working pattern and the plan's documented owner-tested hold body. Confirmed against swagger: VATRate is 'Relevant for items only' and 'Leave empty for company default' — omitting it is a documented, supported path.

authorize.ts: DraftDocument's forced-draft clause in swagger is tied to AuthoriseOnly (never sent), not AutoCapture — the help-article claim that J5 Orders are always draft is a SEPARATE, undocumented-in-swagger behavior. Worth a live check of one real hold's Billing_Status/document draft-state before trusting either source alone.
